translated: The future Alicia desired...

The world has become far too warped...
I have to guide it in a better direction, even just a little.
That is... the duty left to us.
I will go to Asgard.

I must return Gungnir,
the spear that protects Asgard...

If you were the supreme god, we undead
might be spared from quarreling with the gods forever.

I wonder what look
that Fray woman will make.
...I'm counting on you.

...Apparently, in this world,
I've ceased to be one of the undead.
What did you say!?
I can feel death.
It brings back the memory of the one time I felt it, ages ago.
...Not bad.
I've found a good place to die.
You intend to stay here!?
As an undead, I have no place to return to.
Same here. I'll keep you company.
I decline.

You, who were once human, still have a great task left:
the rebuilding of Midgard...
...You're telling me to become the Orb's guardian?
Who else would there be?
Everyone settles where they ought to settle.
